brief.zh: a 说：「b 是无赖。」b 什么也没说。c 说：「a 和 b 是同一种人。」设计一个证明助手：推得出的身份证出来，推不出的报告失败。
brief.en: a says: “b is a knave.” b says nothing. c says: “a and b are the same kind.” Design a proof assistant that proves what follows about them and reports failure on what does not.

hint.zh: 不是每个人的身份都定得下来。
hint.en: Not everyone’s kind can be settled.
